name: Ideation
description: Capture, evaluate, and execute on new ideas.

columns.name: ideas
columns.label: Ideas
columns.description: Raw ideas captured for future evaluation.
columns.hint: Move here to capture any idea worth considering, no matter how rough.

columns.name: evaluating
columns.label: Evaluating
columns.description: Ideas under active assessment for viability and fit.
columns.hint: Move here when the idea is being researched, discussed, or prototyped.

columns.name: approved
columns.label: Approved
columns.description: Ideas validated and committed for execution.
columns.hint: Move here once the idea has stakeholder buy-in and a clear scope.

columns.name: executing
columns.label: Executing
columns.description: Approved ideas actively being built or shipped.
columns.hint: Move here when active development or implementation begins.

columns.name: done
columns.label: Done
columns.hint: Move here when the idea has been fully implemented and is live.
